mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Akali's basic attacks deal additional magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Gain damage on hit based on ability power
Gain spell vamp based on attack damage
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Discipline of Force: Upon obtaining @ForceThreshold@ Ability Power Akali's basic attacks deal a bonus @BaseDamageOnHit@% magic damage. Increasing by 1% per 6 Ability Power gained thereafter.

(Total Bonus: @TotalForceTT@% magic damage).

Discipline of Might: Upon obtaining @MightThreshold@ Bonus Attack Damage Akali gains @BaseSpellVampPercent@% Spell Vamp. Increasing by an additional 1% Spell Vamp per 6 Bonus Attack Damage gained thereafter.

(Total Bonus: @TotalSpellVampTT@% Spell Vamp).
Akali can dash to the marked target and strike them.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Akali flourishes her kamas, dealing damage based on her Attack Damage and Ability Power.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Akali flourishes her kamas, slicing nearby enemies for <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Assassin's Mark</titleLeft><mainText>If Akali hits this unit, the mark will trigger and deal magic damage to them.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Akali spins her kama at a target enemy to deal magic damage and mark the target for 6 seconds. Akali's melee attacks against a marked target will trigger and consume the mark to cause additional damage and restore Energy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Akali throws her kama at a target enemy to deal @InitialDamage@ magic damage and mark the target for 6 seconds.

Akali's melee attacks against a marked target will consume the mark to cause @ProcDamage@ magic damage and restore @EnergyReturn@ Energy.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing damage and consuming an Essence of Shadow charge. Akali recharges Essence of Shadow charges both periodically and upon kills and assists, max 3 stacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Akali stores an Essence of Shadow on kills and assists as well as every @AmmoRechargeTime@ seconds up to 3 total.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Twilight Shroud</titleLeft><mainText>Akali has increased Armor and Magic Resist.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Twilight Shroud</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has reduced Movement Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Akali is <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and cannot be seen by enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Akali throws down a cover of smoke. While inside the area, Akali gains Armor and Magic Resist and becomes invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her. Enemies inside the smoke have their Movement Speed reduced.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Akali throws down a cover of smoke that lasts for 8 seconds. While inside the area, Akali gains @TotalResists@ Armor and @TotalResists@ Magic Resist and becomes Invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

Enemies inside the smoke are Slowed by @SlowAmount@%.
